input: I'm an app-layer engineer trying to understand why our AI inference workload is slower on the new C1 cores with SME2 than on the old Cortex-A725 with NEON. The vendor says SME2 should accelerate matrix operations. We're using a quantized INT8 model. Could the MXFP6 support in ARMv9.7 help, and what's the difference between running inference on CPU via SME2 vs offloading to NPU? I need a business-level summary for my manager too.
